title: Who Can Earn Money with GroMo? From Loan Agents to Homemakers
summary: Who can earn money with GroMo: 16 profiles from loan agents to students and retired people, their real problems, what each can sell, payouts and how to start.
body_markdown:
Who can earn money with GroMo? Anyone in India who is 18 or older and has an Android phone, a PAN card and a bank account in their own name can earn money with GroMo. You earn a commission when a customer you refer is approved for a credit card, savings account, demat account, loan or investment product. Joining is free, and commission is credited after the bank or provider confirms the sale, up to ₹2,000 for some credit cards (GroMo product catalogue, retrieved 2026-11-25).


GroMo suits two kinds of people. Some already sell finance, like loan agents, mutual fund distributors and bank mitras, and want more products in one app. Others want flexible side income, like students, homemakers, gig workers and retired people. Below, each of the 16 profiles gets its own section with the problems they face, what they can sell and how to start.


## 16 Types of People Who Earn with GroMo: Quick Comparison


The table below matches each profile to the products that usually fit their network and the time it takes.

## What You Need to Start Earning with GroMo


Every new GroMo partner asks the same six questions before joining. Here are the short answers.


Question Answer for GroMo


Who can join? Any Indian resident aged 18 or older with an Android phone, a mobile number, a PAN card and a bank account in their own name


What do you actually do? Share a product link with a customer, help them apply, and earn a commission when the bank or provider approves them


When do you work and get paid? Any time you choose, with no fixed hours or targets. Commission is credited to the GroMo wallet after the provider confirms the sale


Where do you work from? From your phone, anywhere in India: at home, at your shop, between gigs or on social media


Why do people choose GroMo? It is free to join, needs no stock or shop, gives free training in the app, and pays real money to your bank account


How do you start? Install the app, register with your mobile number, complete KYC with PAN, finish training, then share your first product link

## Already Selling Finance? How GroMo Adds to Your Income


Agents who sell credit and cards, advisors, BFSI staff, MFDs, bank mitras and LIC agents already talk to customers about money. For them GroMo is a way to offer more products without signing new agreements with each bank.


### 1. Loan Agents and DSAs: Offer More Lenders Without New Tie-Ups


Who it suits Loan agents, DSAs and loan connectors


What to offer first Personal loans, business loans and credit lines


Time needed Full time or part time


Your biggest advantage Customers you already have, plus a second lender when one says no


Loan agents in India search "loan dsa" about 2,400 times a month and "dsa registration" about 880 times (Google Keyword Planner, India, retrieved 2026-11-25).


Most loan agents run into the same three problems: - Each lender needs a separate DSA code, paperwork and relationship manager. - A customer rejected by one lender is often lost, because the agent has no second option. - Payout tracking across many lenders is slow and unclear.


GroMo lists personal and business loans from many RBI-regulated banks and NBFCs in one app, so anyone working as a[loan agent](https://gromo.in/blog/what-is-a-loan-agent/) can offer a second lender without a new tie-up. Each lead is tracked in the app, and the payout for each product is shown before you share the link. The lender alone decides approval, interest rate and terms.


To get started: 1. Register on GroMo and complete KYC. 2. Open the Personal Loan section and compare eligibility rules for each lender. 3. Send customers who were declined elsewhere to a lender whose rules fit their profile.


### 2. Credit Card Agents: Place More Customers Across Many Banks


Who it suits Credit card agents, card DSAs and bank card promoters


What to offer first Credit cards and secured credit cards


Time needed Full time or part time


Your biggest advantage Cards from many banks, so a rejected customer can still be placed


Anyone who works as a[credit card agent](https://gromo.in/blog/what-is-a-credit-card-agent/) usually loses money and time in these ways: - Working for one bank means losing every customer that bank rejects. - Customers with no credit history are hard to place. - Commission differs widely by bank and is often unclear.


GroMo has credit cards and secured credit cards from many banks in one app. A customer rejected for one card can try a card with different rules, and a customer with no credit history can be offered a secured card against a fixed deposit. Credit cards carry the highest payouts in the GroMo catalogue, up to ₹2,000 per approved card as of 25 November 2026.


To get started: 1. Learn the eligibility rules of 3 or 4 cards from the in-app training. 2. Ask each customer about income and existing cards before you share a link. 3. Offer a secured card to customers with no credit history.


### 3. Financial Advisors: Meet Every Client Need from One App


Who it suits Independent financial advisors and planners


What to offer first Savings accounts, demat accounts, credit cards and investment products


Time needed A few hours a week, alongside advisory work


Your biggest advantage Clients who already trust your advice on money


Financial advisors often hit these limits: - Clients ask for help with cards, accounts and loans, not only investments. - Tie-ups with many providers take time and paperwork. - Advisory fees alone can be uneven month to month.


GroMo lets an advisor help a client open a demat account, a savings account or get a credit card from one app, and earn a commission on each approved application. GroMo is a distribution platform: you share products, you do not give regulated investment advice through GroMo. Advisors who give paid investment advice need their own SEBI registration.


To get started: 1. List the 5 most common requests your clients make. 2. Match each to a product category in the app. 3. Share links only where the product genuinely fits the client.


### 4. BFSI Professionals: Turn Your Banking Knowledge into Extra Income


Who it suits Bank, NBFC and other BFSI staff, such as sales executives and relationship officers


What to offer first Products your employer does not sell (only if your contract allows it)


Time needed Evenings and weekends


Your biggest advantage Strong product knowledge: eligibility, KYC and credit scores


BFSI professionals often feel stuck for these reasons: - A fixed salary with sales targets on one company's products. - Product knowledge that earns nothing outside office hours. - Strong contacts who ask for products your employer does not offer.


BFSI professionals already understand eligibility, KYC and credit scores, which is most of the skill GroMo needs. GroMo lets them help their network with products from many providers.


**Important:** many banks and NBFCs do not allow staff to sell other companies' products. Read your employment contract and conflict-of-interest policy, and ask HR before you join. Never sell a competitor's product to your employer's customers.


To get started: 1. Check your employer's rules in writing. 2. If allowed, focus on products your employer does not sell. 3. Keep GroMo work fully outside office hours and office systems.


### 5. Mutual Fund Distributors: Earn While Your Trail Income Builds


Who it suits AMFI-registered mutual fund distributors (MFDs)


What to offer first Demat accounts, savings accounts and credit cards


Time needed Part time, alongside your MF business


Your biggest advantage An investor base that already needs these accounts


India had 2,07,202 ARN holders with a valid registration in September 2026 (Cafemutual analysis of AMFI data). Many of them[became mutual fund distributors](https://gromo.in/blog/how-to-become-mutual-fund-distributor/) only recently and are still building their client book.


New mutual fund distributors usually struggle with: - Trail commission grows slowly in the first years. - Clients need other products, like a demat account or a credit card, that the MFD cannot offer. - Competition from direct plans and apps.


An MFD can help existing clients open a demat account (up to ₹642 per account as of 25 November 2026) or a savings account, and offer credit cards, all from one app. This earns one-time commission while trail income builds.


To get started: 1. Start with clients who already asked about demat or cards. 2. Keep your ARN-based mutual fund work separate from GroMo products. 3. Never present a GroMo product as investment advice.


### 6. Bank Mitras and CSP Operators: Earn More from Walk-In Customers


Who it suits Bank mitras, business correspondents (BCs) and CSP operators


What to offer first Savings accounts, credit cards and small loans


Time needed Idle hours at your counter


Your biggest advantage Daily walk-in customers who trust you with money


Bank mitras and CSP operators deal with these problems every day: - Low fees per transaction and pressure on margins. - Many visitors want products the CSP's partner bank does not offer. - Long hours at the counter with idle gaps.


Anyone who runs a[bank mitra or CSP](https://gromo.in/blog/bank-mitra-csp/) counter already has walk-in customers who trust them with money. GroMo lets the operator offer savings accounts and credit cards from other providers during idle time, on the operator's own phone.


**Important:** your BC agreement with your bank or corporate BC may limit what you can sell at the CSP. Check it before you offer other banks' products at the counter.


To get started: 1. Read your BC agreement. 2. Offer savings accounts first, since your customers already understand them. 3. Explain clearly that the product comes from another bank, not the CSP's bank.


### 7. LIC Agents: Add Non-Insurance Products for Your Policyholders


Who it suits LIC agents and other life insurance agents


What to offer first Credit cards, loans, savings and demat accounts (no insurance)


Time needed Part time


Your biggest advantage A large network of families you already serve


"LIC agent" is searched about 12,100 times a month in India (Google Keyword Planner, India, retrieved 2026-11-25). Many agents look for more income from the same network.


**GroMo does not offer insurance.** You cannot sell LIC policies or any insurance through GroMo. What an LIC agent can do is help the same families with non-insurance needs.


Here is where most LIC agents feel the pinch: - New policy sales are slow, and renewal commission takes years to build. - Policyholders ask for loans and cards the agent cannot provide.


An LIC agent has a large, trusting network. GroMo lets the agent offer credit cards, personal loans and savings accounts to that network and earn a commission on each approval.


**Important:** read your LIC agency agreement and check with your branch before you join any other platform.` \[VERIFY: LIC agency rules on distributing non-insurance products, with a primary source\]`


To get started: 1. Confirm your agency terms allow it. 2. Start with policyholders who asked about loans or cards. 3. Keep insurance and GroMo products clearly separate in every conversation.


## Looking for Side Income? How GroMo Fits Around Your Work


Gig workers, freelancers, part-time workers, content creators and affiliate marketers want income that fits around other work. GroMo suits them because there are no fixed hours and no targets.


### 8. Gig Workers: Turn Idle Time Between Orders into Income


Who it suits Delivery partners, cab drivers and other platform workers


What to offer first Savings accounts and credit cards


Time needed Gaps between orders and off days


Your biggest advantage You meet many new people every day


India had about 77 lakh gig workers in 2020-21, and NITI Aayog expects 2.35 crore by 2029-30 (NITI Aayog, India's Booming Gig and Platform Economy, June 2022).


Gig work has well-known ups and downs: - Income goes up and down with orders, season and platform incentives. - No paid leave, and earnings stop when you stop driving. - Long idle waits between orders.


A gig worker meets many people and has idle gaps every day. GroMo work happens on the same phone, and one approved credit card can add more to a day than several short trips. GroMo does not replace gig income, it adds a second stream.


To get started: 1. Start with friends and fellow riders who need a savings account or first credit card. 2. Use idle time between orders to follow up on applications. 3. Never share links while driving.


### 9. Freelancers: Fill the Quiet Months Between Projects


Who it suits Writers, designers, developers and video editors


What to offer first Credit cards and demat accounts


Time needed Quiet weeks between client projects


Your biggest advantage A professional network that is starting to earn and invest


Freelance income is rarely steady: - Client payments are irregular. - Platform fees cut into earnings. - Dry months with no projects.


Freelancers often know other freelancers who need a credit card or a demat account. GroMo commission does not depend on a client brief or a platform fee, and it can fill quiet months.


To get started: 1. Share a short, honest post about a card you use yourself. 2. Help freelancer friends who are starting to invest open a demat account. 3. Track each lead in the app, like a mini project.


### 10. Part-Time Workers: Earn in 1 to 3 Hours a Day With No Fee


Who it suits Anyone with a few free hours a day


What to offer first Any product, starting with savings accounts


Time needed 1 to 3 hours a day, at a time you choose


Your biggest advantage No shifts, no targets and no joining fee


"Part time work from home" is searched about 49,500 times a month in India (Google Keyword Planner, India, retrieved 2026-11-25), and many results are fake jobs that ask for a fee.


People looking for part-time work face two big problems: - Most part-time jobs need fixed shifts. - Many online "jobs" ask for a registration fee, a classic scam sign.


Unlike many[part-time online jobs without investment](https://gromo.in/blog/part-time-online-jobs-without-investment/) that later ask for money, GroMo is free to join and never asks for a fee. You choose your hours, and there are no targets. It is commission work, not a salaried job, so income depends on approved sales.


To get started: 1. Fix a daily slot, for example 7 to 9 pm. 2. Learn one product category fully before adding a second. 3. Follow up on pending applications in the same slot.


### 11. Content Creators: Earn per Approval, Not per View


Who it suits YouTubers, Instagram creators and Telegram or WhatsApp channel owners


What to offer first Credit cards, savings and demat accounts


Time needed Alongside your regular content


Your biggest advantage An audience that already asks you what to use


Creators know these money problems well: - Brand deals are irregular and depend on follower count. - Ad revenue is low for small and mid-sized creators.


A creator who explains a credit card or a savings account can share the GroMo link with that content and earn when viewers are approved. Small creators with a loyal niche audience can earn too, because the payout is per approval, not per view.


**Rules to follow:** label paid or commission links as advertising, as ASCI influencer guidelines require. Do not give investment advice or return promises.


To get started: 1. Make one honest explainer on a product you understand. 2. Put the link in the description or bio with a clear disclosure. 3. Answer viewer questions in comments.


### 12. Affiliate Marketers: Higher Payouts Than Shopping Links


Who it suits Bloggers, deal-page owners and affiliate marketers


What to offer first Credit cards, demat and savings account links


Time needed Alongside your site or page work


Your biggest advantage Higher payout per approval than most shopping links


"Affiliate marketing" is searched about 110,000 times a month in India (Google Keyword Planner, India, retrieved 2026-11-25).


Affiliate marketers selling shopping links face low earnings: - Shopping affiliate commissions are a small percentage of a low order value. - Cookie windows are short.


One approved financial product can pay more than many shopping sales, for example up to ₹2,000 for an approved credit card as of 25 November 2026. You share links for real products from regulated providers.


To get started: 1. Pick one product category that fits your audience. 2. Write honest content with fees and eligibility, not only rewards. 3. Disclose that you earn a commission.


## Earning from Home, College, Your Shop or Retirement


Homemakers, students, shopkeepers and retired people want income that fits family life, studies, a shop or retirement.


### 13. Homemakers: Your Own Income, on Your Own Time


Who it suits Homemakers and women returning to work


What to offer first Savings accounts first, then credit cards


Time needed Flexible, around family time


Your biggest advantage Relatives, neighbours and local WhatsApp groups


Homemakers who want their own income often face: - Fixed-hour jobs do not fit family time. - Many "work from home" offers ask for a deposit first. - No income of your own.


Among[work from home jobs for housewives](https://gromo.in/blog/work-from-home-jobs-for-housewives/) , GroMo is one that needs no deposit: a homemaker can share links with relatives, neighbours and local WhatsApp groups from home, at any hour. Commission goes to the homemaker's own bank account, which needs a PAN card and an account in her own name.


To get started: 1. Open a bank account in your own name if you do not have one. 2. Start with savings accounts, the easiest product to explain. 3. Join the free in-app training before moving to credit cards.


### 14. Students (18+): Earn After Classes Without a Fixed Job


Who it suits College students aged 18 or older with a PAN card and own bank account


What to offer first Savings and demat accounts


Time needed After classes and on weekends


Your biggest advantage Friends opening their first bank or demat account


**GroMo is only for people aged 18 or older** with a PAN card and their own bank account.


Students who want to earn usually run into: - Part-time jobs clash with class timings. - Many online earning apps pay in coins or vouchers.


Students know many young people opening their first savings or demat account. Compared with most[online part-time jobs for students](https://gromo.in/blog/online-part-time-jobs-for-students/) , GroMo pays real money to the student's bank account, not coins, and there are no fixed hours.


To get started: 1. Get a PAN card and a bank account in your own name. 2. Start with savings and demat accounts for friends who already need one. 3. Do not push credit cards or loans on students with no income.


### 15. Shopkeepers: Earn More from Customers Who Already Trust You


Who it suits Kirana, mobile, medical and general store owners


What to offer first Credit cards, savings accounts and credit lines


Time needed Quiet hours at the counter


Your biggest advantage Regular customers who already trust you


Shopkeepers know this situation well: - Thin margins on goods. - The same customers every day, with no extra way to earn from that trust.


A shopkeeper's customers already trust them. GroMo lets the shopkeeper help those customers get a credit card, a savings account or a credit line, with no stock and no extra space. GroMo data from 2026 shows small merchants are among its highest-value partners.


To get started: 1. Put up a small sign saying you help with cards and accounts. 2. Ask regular customers, not walk-ins, first. 3. Help with the application on the customer's own phone, never with their documents on yours.


### 16. Retired People: Use Your Network and Experience to Earn


Who it suits Retired government, bank and private-sector employees


What to offer first Savings accounts, credit cards and investment products


Time needed Flexible, a few hours a day


Your biggest advantage A wide network and years of experience with paperwork


Many retired people find that: - A fixed pension against rising costs. - Free time and experience that go unused.


Retired people often have a wide, trusting network and time to help people with paperwork. Retired bankers in particular already know KYC and eligibility. There is no upper age limit to join GroMo` \[VERIFY: confirm no upper age limit with the GroMo team\]` .


To get started: 1. Ask a family member to help with the app install and KYC if needed. 2. Start with people from your own society or former workplace. 3. Never ask anyone for an OTP, PIN or password.


## Which GroMo Profile Fits You Best?


Most people fit more than one profile. Start with the one where you already have people who trust you.


- **You already have customers asking about loans or cards:** start as a loan agent or credit card agent (profiles 1 and 2).
- **You have clients who save or invest:** start with demat and savings accounts, like an advisor or mutual fund distributor (profiles 3 and 5).
- **You run a counter or a shop:** offer savings accounts and cards to regulars, like a CSP operator or shopkeeper (profiles 6 and 15).
- **You have an online audience:** share product links with honest content, like a creator or affiliate marketer (profiles 11 and 12).
- **You have 1 to 3 free hours a day:** start with savings accounts, which are the easiest to explain (profiles 10, 13, 14 and 16).


## Who GroMo Is Not Right For


GroMo is not a fit for everyone. Be honest with yourself before you join.


- **Under 18:** you cannot join.
- **No PAN or bank account in your own name:** you cannot receive commission.
- **You need a fixed monthly salary:** GroMo pays commission per approved sale, not a salary.
- **Your employer or agency forbids it:** check your contract first (bank staff, BCs, insurance agents).
- **You want to sell insurance:** GroMo does not offer insurance.


## How to Start Earning with GroMo in 4 Steps


Starting on GroMo takes four steps and is free.


1. **Install the app:** download GroMo from the Google Play Store. GroMo is on Android.
2. **Register:** sign up with your mobile number.
3. **Complete KYC:** add your PAN card and the bank account where you want your commission.
4. **Train and share:** finish the free training for one product, then share your first product link with a customer who needs it.


After a customer applies, track the application in the app. When the provider confirms the sale, the commission is credited to your GroMo wallet, and you can withdraw it to your bank account.

## 5 Mistakes New GroMo Partners Should Avoid


- **Sharing links with everyone:** wrong-fit customers get rejected, which wastes your time and theirs. Check eligibility first.
- **Promising approval:** only the bank decides. Never tell a customer they will surely get a card or loan.
- **Asking for OTPs or passwords:** never. The customer applies on their own phone.
- **Ignoring your contract:** bank staff, BCs and agents must check their agreements first.
- **Trusting fake GroMo pages:** GroMo never charges a joining fee, which is the quickest way to check whether[GroMo is real or fake](https://gromo.in/blog/is-gromo-real-or-fake/) .

## FAQ: Who Can Earn Money with GroMo


New partners ask these questions most often before joining GroMo.


### Who can join GroMo?


Any Indian resident aged 18 or older can join GroMo. You need an Android phone, a mobile number, a PAN card and a bank account in your own name. No degree, licence or sales experience is needed to start.


### Is GroMo free to join?


Yes. GroMo charges no joining fee, no training fee and no fee for product links. Any person or page asking you to pay to join GroMo is not GroMo.


### Can students earn with GroMo?


Yes, if they are 18 or older and have a PAN card and their own bank account. Students under 18 cannot join.


### Do I need a licence to earn with GroMo?


No licence is needed to refer credit cards, savings accounts, demat accounts or loans through GroMo. Paid investment advice is different and needs SEBI registration.


### Can LIC agents sell insurance on GroMo?


No. GroMo does not offer insurance. LIC agents can use GroMo only for non-insurance products such as credit cards, loans and savings accounts, after checking their agency terms.


### How do GroMo partners get paid?


Commission is credited to your GroMo wallet after the bank or provider confirms the sale. You then withdraw it to your own bank account.


### How much can I earn with GroMo?


Income is not fixed and not guaranteed. It depends on approved sales and the products you sell. Payouts per product are shown in the app, ranging up to ₹2,000 for some credit cards as of 25 November 2026.


### Can I use GroMo part time?


Yes. GroMo has no fixed hours and no targets, so you can work 1 hour a day or full time.


## Disclosures


GroMo (Vitrak Technologies Pvt Ltd) is a distribution platform. GroMo is not a bank, NBFC, insurer or investment adviser. All products are offered by their respective RBI or SEBI-regulated providers, who alone decide approval, interest rates and terms.


Loans and credit cards are issued by RBI-regulated banks and NBFCs. Approval is at the lender's sole discretion and is never promised. Investments are subject to market risks; read all scheme-related documents carefully.


Partner earnings depend on effort, product mix and customer eligibility. Any figures shown are illustrative examples. They are not typical and are not guaranteed. GroMo does not guarantee any level of income.
